name: Meptazinol
summary: Meptazinol, sold under the brand name Meptid, is an opioid analgesic developed by Wyeth in the 1970s. Indications for use in moderate to severe pain, most commonly used to treat pain in obstetrics (childbirth).

pharmacology.text: A partial μ-opioid receptor agonist, its mixed agonist/antagonist activity affords it a lower risk of dependence and abuse than full μ agonists like morphine.

body.says: The peak analgesic effect is seen within 30–60 minutes and lasts about 3–4 hours
The drug is rapidly metabolized to the glucuronide, and mostly excreted in the urine

summaryZh: 美普他酚（英語：Meptazinol，商品名有Meptid等）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C15H23NO，屬於合成類阿片物質，1970年代由惠氏公司開發，在產科學中用於緩解分娩疼痛。
